args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel documents (flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Travel insurance information
- Medications and prescriptions

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and shopping
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Water shoes or reef walkers for snorkeling
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes for Diamond Head
- Flip flops or sandals
- Hat with wide brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkel gear (mask, snorkel, fins) - optional as rentals available
- Beach bag
- Quick-dry clothing

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking gear for Diamond Head
- Water bottle/hydration pack
- Trail snacks
- Small backpack
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit

EVENING ACTIVITIES:
- Luau-appropriate attire (aloha shirt, floral dress, etc.)
- Semi-casual outfit for nicer dinners
- Jewelry/accessories

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Travel-sized toiletries
- Hairbrush/comb
- Travel laundry detergent (for hand washing)
- Reusable water bottle
- Books or e-reader for relaxation days
- Travel pillow for flights
- Ziplock bags for wet items

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- June 11 (Waikiki Beach): Beach toys, cooler
- June 12 (Hanauma Bay snorkeling): Underwater camera
- June 13 (Diamond Head hiking): Trekking poles (optional)
- June 14 (Pearl Harbor): Respectful attire
- June 15 (North Shore road trip): Car snacks, playlist
- June 16 (Luau): Hawaiian accessories
- June 17 (Spa day): Spa sandals if preferred
- June 18 (Kailua Beach kayaking): Waterproof watch
- June 19 (Shopping): Reusable shopping bags

Remember to check weather forecasts before departure and adjust accordingly!
